description: A Bash shell script for setting up and testing SVN repositories with various checks and utilities, including configuration, repository creation, and environment preparation.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Wrapper function for executing SVN commands with a specified config directory.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Function that conditionally starts a local HTTP server for SVN if environment conditions are met.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Perl-based function to convert input data into an SVN revision database format.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks whether svnserve utility should be used or tests should be skipped.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts an svnserve process listening on a specified port.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares the environment for UTF-8 locale testing by inspecting system locale and environment variables.

methods.name: skip_all
methods.description: Variable used for skipping tests with a message, set upon failed prerequisites.
